methodology.timing: Wall time includes vp launch and all child processes; /usr/bin/time -l measures peak RSS and CPU on macOS
methodology.cold: Task caches removed, dependencies installed and OS file cache warm; not a cold machine
methodology.baselineHarness: Only command orchestration is translated to vp; original tools, source and test exclusions remain. Legacy test user-agent is fixed to its previous pnpm context. Node symlinks in baseline .bin directories ensure Node 24.18.0 for Turbo child workloads. Turbo cache is isolated.
methodology.programNote: The matched typed tier includes all nine test files on both sides. The real old workflow still checks only one test file. Current lint also runs dependency/secret JS plugins; rule sets are not identical.
methodology.comparisonScope: The first four cases use identical source seeds on 28 files. Full verification compares real workflows: the current formatter covers Markdown, MDX and Astro too, and current lint covers scripts throughout apps and examples. Source/test type guards remain explicit.
methodology.baselineEnvironmentRepairs: Baseline was moved outside the main repository to avoid nested Biome roots. Local CLI links were regenerated; .bin/node links pin Node 24.18.0 for Turbo children. The exact locked satteri 0.10.5 native package was linked into the two apps after the fresh baseline SSR bundle could not resolve it. No application or framework source changes were made.
